GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled back near last 10+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide, without cover, in e&m stages. Hampered app 200m.  Rdr stated mount failed to travel strongly at any stage of the event & he was required to continually encourage it along just to hold a position at rear of field. Rdr stated mount did not feel comfortable on heavy track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . Settled Down Inside 3rd, 2 Lengths @ 1000m. plenty of room Immediately on Straightening Up . winner railed/used cutaway, this Just No Match # given Every Chance

Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced keenly 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Back 1 length to 4th Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & briefly challenged leaders @ 200m. Weakened on inside in last 150m. blinkers off first time. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 500m became held up on heels and was unable to improve until the entrance to the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was steadied after being carried out across the heels of a runner by another runner, which shifted out.
